metadata.description: Lou Lohman's Claude Code skills — a verification-first all-in-one SEO auditor, a guided cross-codebase parity workflow, and token-lean compaction-surviving persistence.

plugins.name: ltl-seo
plugins.description: All-in-one, verification-first SEO: technical, on-page, structured data, local SEO (Business Profile, LocalBusiness markup, NAP), internal linking & site architecture, keyword & content strategy, competitor analysis, AEO/AI-visibility, programmatic-SEO-at-scale, and measurement/iteration. Inspects the real source/HTML (all three structured-data syntaxes) before claiming anything is missing, web-verifies time-sensitive guidance, pushes back on deprecated tactics, and never promises rankings.

plugins.name: ltl-parity
plugins.description: Guided cross-codebase parity for keeping two (or more) related projects in sync — e.g. a website and its companion app. Classifies every change, warns on safety/security/ambiguous risk, and verifies both sides instead of blindly copying.

plugins.name: ltl-persistence
plugins.description: Token-lean, compaction-surviving persistence: set up and maintain a 'resume-here' handoff, an optional user-defined standing-rules file, and an opt-in PreCompact hook — all wired into Claude Code's native auto-loaded layer so work survives compaction at minimum token cost. Ships zero rules of its own.
